It's okay to feel overwhelmed."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I thought things were getting better with Bob's new job and the positive feedback from my boss. But now it feels like I'm back at square one with worry."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Progress isn't always a straight line, although it feels like a setback now, you've managed so much already. You're very strong."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thank you for saying that. It's just hard to see my kids go through this. Focusing on those positives can help ground you during tough times."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I miss having Jerry around, though.
